a16z-fivetran:greenhouse:7659456003.description: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About the Role We are seeking a Senior Pricing Operations Manager to ensure our pricing policies are accurately reflected and consistently executed across Salesforce CPQ, ERP, and other quoting systems. In this role, you’ll translate approved pricing policies, promotions, bundles, and discount structures—defined by Pricing Leadership—into system configurations that Sales can confidently use. This role focuses specifically on operationalizing pricing policy within systems and providing guidance to Sales on pricing scenarios. You will work closely with the Revenue Proposal-to-Order Lead, who owns the broader CPQ architecture, guided quoting processes, and proposal automation tooling. Together, you’ll ensure pricing policies are executed correctly within the quoting framework. This is a full-time, hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or Denver, CO offices. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. What You’ll Do System Operationalization of Pricing Policy Translate approved pricing policies (discounts, promotions, bundles, and special terms) into business requirements that our GTM systems team can use to build configurable rules and logic within Salesforce CPQ, ERP, and related pricing systems. Define pricing matrices, discount waterfalls, product catalogs, approval flows, and quoting templates for pricing accuracy and consistency. Partner with the Proposal-to-Order Lead and IT/Systems teams to design, test, and troubleshoot pricing configurations within the CPQ framework. Develop and maintain documentation for pricing-related system configurations and policies. Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements in pricing logic and quoting processes. Quoting Operations Support Act as a subject matter expert on pricing policies for Sales and Deal Desk Provide training and enablement for sales teams on new pricing policies, system updates, and pricing best practices. Field Feedback & Pricing Insights Gather feedback from Sales, Customer Success, and field teams on pricing effectiveness, customer sentiment, and operational challenges. Analyze recurring themes and pain points, synthesizing them into recommendations for pricing policy improvements. Collaborate with Pricing Strategy, Product, and Sales leadership to inform future pricing and packaging decisions with operational insights. What We’re Looking For 5–7 years of experience in Pricing Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar analytical role, preferably in B2B SaaS or technology. Proven experience defining pricing rules and partnering with engineers to implement them in CRM/CPQ systems (Salesforce CPQ preferred; Oracle CPQ, Zuora CPQ also valued). Strong understanding of pricing methodologies, discount structures, and SaaS sales motions, usage economics. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights. Strong communicator who can clearly explain complex pricing concepts to Sales and cross-functional teams. Highly detail-oriented with a commitment to pricing accuracy and data integrity. Proficiency in Google Sheets, Hex, Looker, or similar tools for pricing analytics. Bonus Skills Familiarity with financial reporting and revenue recognition principles. Project management experience coordinating cross-functional pricing initiatives. #LI-Hybrid #LI-MT2 The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. uppartners-hermeus:lever:44c7cfd7-af73-4.description: Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage. We are seeking a Quality Inspector to join our growing team and ensure the highest level of quality and reliability across all hardware produced at our facility. As one of the first inspectors on-site, you will play a key role in establishing inspection standards, methods, and processes to support the production of precision aerospace and defense components. This position requires a highly detail-oriented, hands-on professional with a deep understanding of mechanical inspection, precision measurement, and documentation practices. You’ll work directly with manufacturing, quality engineering, and design teams to ensure all parts meet dimensional and process conformance requirements — from prototype through production.
responsibilities: Perform dimensional and visual inspections on complex mechanical and welded components using precision measurement tools and equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers, height gauges, CMM, FARO arm).
Verify parts and assemblies against engineering drawings, models, and specifications using GD&T principles.
Conduct in-process, first-article, and final inspections, ensuring all product meets design and process requirements prior to release.
Review and interpret engineering drawings, work orders, and technical documentation to identify inspection criteria.
Create, complete, and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance documentation, and traceability records in accordance with internal quality standards.
Collaborate cross-functionally with manufacturing engineers, technicians, and quality engineers to drive root cause analysis and corrective action on non-conformances.
Assist in the development of inspection methods, tooling, and quality procedures to improve efficiency and repeatability.
Support supplier part verification and incoming inspection for purchased or outsourced components.
Maintain and calibrate inspection tools and gages in compliance with calibration schedules and quality system requirements.
Contribute to a continuous improvement culture focused on process capability, accuracy, and throughput.
qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical certification in mechanical inspection, manufacturing, or metrology preferred.
3+ years of hands-on experience in mechanical inspection within aerospace, defense, or high-precision manufacturing environments.
Strong proficiency with precision measurement tools and metrology equipment, including CMMs and optical measurement systems.
Working knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and the ability to interpret complex engineering drawings.
Experience inspecting tight-tolerance metallic components such as machined, welded, or sheet metal assemblies.
Proven ability to document, communicate, and resolve quality issues effectively in collaboration with engineering teams.
Experience with CMM programming (PC-DMIS, Verisurf, or similar).
Familiarity with ISO 9001, AS9100, or equivalent quality management systems.
Knowledge of NDT methods (visual, dye penetrant, radiographic, or ultrasonic inspection).
Experience working in a high-mix, low-volume production environment with rapid iteration cycles.
Proficiency with ERP or quality management software systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, or Solumina).
Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Must be willing to be hands-on on the manufacturing floor daily.
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs and work around industrial equipment as needed.
Flexible schedule may be required to support production priorities and critical milestones.

xange-saporo:bamboohr:37.description: Poste : Pre-Sales Cyber Sécurité - France - Europe Lieu de travail : France / Suisse Langues : Français et Anglais courants A propos de nous : Le nombre et la gravité des cyberattaques augmentant chaque année, nous trouvons utile de proposer une technologie de pointe qui aide les organisations à anticiper les attaques et à devenir plus résilientes. Les organisations ont du mal à hiérarchiser les risques lorsque tout est prioritaire. Les attaquants ont tout le temps d'étudier les processus critiques d'une organisation pour trouver des faiblesses dans l'infrastructure. Saporo est à la croisée de la gestion du chemin d'attaque (APM) et de la gestion de l'exposition (EM). Saporo hiérarchise impitoyablement les risques en mesurant les faiblesses qui conduisent à des ressources à fort impact commercial. Saporo identifie les points critiques qui permettent aux menaces connues et inconnues de réussir. Notre approche quantitative fournit une certitude dans la prise de décision basée sur le risque. Pourquoi rejoindre Saporo ? Saporo a été créée en mars 2021 par des chercheurs, des experts en sécurité et des entrepreneurs pour rendre la cybersécurité plus efficace. Vous rejoindrez une petite équipe où de nombreuses décisions techniques importantes sont encore prises. Votre voix comptera. Vous aurez un impact considérable et une grande visibilité sur la plupart des choses. Les valeurs de Saporo : Efficacité, Respect et Responsabilité. En tant que start-up de l'ère post-covid-19, nous sommes entièrement à distance avec la plupart de notre équipe dispersée entre les Etats-Unis et l'Europe ! Nous sommes une start-up basée en Suisse et nous en sommes fiers ! Aperçu du poste : Nous recherchons un avant-vente (Pre-Sales) senior ayant de solides bases dans les technologies Microsoft - en particulier Active Directory et Azure - et, idéalement, une expérience dans la gestion des chemins d'attaque. Vous serez responsable de l'engagement avec les clients, de la compréhension de leurs besoins en matière de sécurité et du positionnement efficace des solutions de Saporo pour répondre à ces besoins. Principales responsabilités : Engagement des clients : Développer une compréhension approfondie des besoins des clients et fournir des solutions sur mesure en accord avec les offres de Saporo. Expertise technique : Démontrer une expertise dans Active Directory, Azure, et la gestion des chemins d'attaque pour répondre aux questions techniques et construire une relation de confiance avec les clients potentiels. Démonstrations de solutions : Organiser des démonstrations de produits, des ateliers et des discussions techniques qui mettent en évidence les avantages des solutions de sécurité de Saporo. Processus de vente collaboratif : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de vente pour élaborer des propositions, des présentations techniques et des stratégies de produits. Connaissance du marché : Se tenir au courant des tendances du secteur, des offres des concurrents et des besoins des clients en matière de cybersécurité et de gestion des accès. Exigences : Expérience : Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans l'avant-vente technique, ou un rôle similaire dans le domaine de la cybersécurité ou de l'infrastructure informatique. Connaissances techniques : Maîtrise de Microsoft Active Directory et Azure, avec une solide compréhension de la gestion des chemins d'attaque. Compétences linguistiques : Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais. Localisation : Le candidat doit être basé en Suisse ou en France et être capable de voyager dans ces régions selon les besoins. Compétences en communication : Capacité à expliquer des informations techniques complexes à des parties prenantes non techniques.
